story_id: STORY-056, STORY-057, STORY-058, STORY-061, STORY-062, STORY-063, STORY-066

description: A failed swipe Archive, an accidental Archive (no Undo toast) and a failed to-do check have no designed feedback, although the API supports undo.
expected: Row returns with a visible error; a toast with Undo after Archive.

note: PH-Inbox and Sheet draw an Archived toast with Undo and a Couldn't archive toast with Try again; the same pair appears on PG-A-InboxMessage. (round 3: still holds)

description: The swipe specimen offers Star and Mute, but the API has no star write and Mute has no stated mapping. The Expo row menu offers Spam and Trash, which the specimen omits.
expected: Swipe and long-press menus list only actions the backend supports, with Spam and Trash reachable.

note: DS-05 swipe specimen now offers Spam and Archive (Mark read / Mark unread on the leading side); Star and Mute are gone and PH-Inbox/Sheet match. (round 3: still holds)

description: The Inbox control set differs per board: Sheet has Search as an icon and no Hide amounts; Split has an inline search field plus Hide amounts (eye) and Important only (star); DS-04 says Filter lives in More while Sheet puts it in the strip. Hide amounts has no amounts to hide on mail. Filter options (Needs reply, Newsletters, Read mail) do not match the Expo categories.

suggested_fix: Remove the eye from Inbox; pick one place for Filter and Important only; align filter options with InboxFilter values.

description: The message board has only Archive and Reply in the strip. Forward and Reply all have no control, so the 6-step Forward path starts with a hunt for an entry point.

description: The same icon-only prominent button (bubble.left) means 'Ask Inbox agent', 'Open chat' and 'Open conversation', and on Agent list the same icon is an ordinary button. The catalog names text labels that the boards never show.
